name: m4-closed-loose-typer

variantDescriptions.base: `claude/typeref-bench-base`: retronym/scala#212 head + scala/scala#11381 + retronym/scala#243 (TypeRef fold) + retronym/scala#244 (unique types compared structurally, uniques table dropped at the end of a run)
variantDescriptions.fast2: `claude/typeref-bench-fast2`: closed scopes with the cheap bookkeeping (state beside the table, `Made` bit), keeping every type that outlives a scope interned; + #243 + #244
variantDescriptions.loose: `claude/typeref-bench-loose`: closed scopes that only keep their types out of the uniques table; types may outlive a scope uninterned. + #243 + #244

description: Timing A/B: do closed scopes pay in the typer once their bookkeeping is gone? `loose` (option D) against `fast2` and the base, all with retronym/scala#243 and #244. One-fork kperf profiles (m4-closed-typeref-kperf, m4-closed-loose-kperf) put loose at +0.4% cycles and fast2 at +1.6..3.2%, inside one-fork noise. Typer only, scala corpus, 5 rounds of separate forks, 8 GB G1, patched JDK 26, M4.
